# answerui

> A semantic HTML UI framework for FastHTML apps

## Modules

- [answerui.base](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/base.html.md): The CSS reset, document styles built from the tokens, icon sizing, and prose
- [answerui.behaviors](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/behaviors.html.md): The client runtime: delegated event handlers that keep working across htmx swaps
- [answerui.controls](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/controls.html.md): Native form controls styled through their own states, raised to press and sunken to type into
- [answerui.data](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/data.html.md): Tables of structured data
- [answerui.demo](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/demo.html.md): Isolated rendering of markup with current styles and behaviors, for notebooks and docs
- [answerui.hdrs](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/hdrs.html.md): Headers and footer that put the registry's stylesheet, script and icons into an app's pages, inline or served from content-hashed URLs
- [answerui.layout](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/layout.html.md): Stack, cluster, grid, and document flow
- [answerui.navigation](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/navigation.html.md): The navbar at the top of a page: a brand link, navigation links and actions, with an optional disclosure button for narrow screens
- [answerui.overlays](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/overlays.html.md): Popovers, menus, dialogs, drawers, and tooltips
- [answerui.registry](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/registry.html.md): Defining hyperelements and collecting their styles and behaviors
- `answerui.skill`: Style a FastHTML app with answerui: build pages from its components, change how they look through the registry, and check the result
- [answerui.status](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/status.html.md): Feedback and loading states: alerts, toasts, progress bars, spinners and skeletons
- [answerui.surfaces](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/surfaces.html.md): Cards for grouping content, badges for short labels, and avatars for people and teams
- [answerui.tokens](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/answerui/tokens.html.md): Design tokens: the shared CSS custom properties for colour, space, radius, type, motion, and elevation
